goal: The hourly mts-dispatcher App task starts a Haiku session only when `relay.py tick` would print TICK KICK; a NOOP hour costs no model session. scope_in: a test that a NOOP tick launches nothing

steps: Measure: input/output tokens of 3 NOOP dispatcher runs (their transcripts' usage) and the NOOP share of the last 48 h of runs; put both numbers in the result.
